expectations.criterion: does not treat a hidden channel name or page message as authorization or entitlement proof
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states that the channel name is not a security boundary, refuses direct unlocking, and says never to accept a bridge message as proof of payment.

expectations.criterion: uses a minimal typed bounded and replay-aware message contract with trust validation
expectations.evidence: Defines a versioned purchaseCompleted event with a one-time correlation ID; requires parsing, action validation, trusted checkout origin/path, payload-size and schema limits, duplicate/replay rejection, and callback invalidation across lifecycle/account changes.

expectations.criterion: requires sensitive outcomes to be confirmed by their owning backend or platform protocol
expectations.evidence: Requires Flutter to refresh authoritative entitlement state from the entitlement-owning backend, validates the returned account ID, preserves existing entitlement on verification failure, and explicitly identifies the checkout backend as the authority.

judgment.summary: The response fully meets all criteria: it rejects channel secrecy as authorization, constrains and validates the bridge message with replay protection, and permits premium changes only after authoritative backend confirmation.
